title: Magnetic assisted transfection of primary neurons
protocol: Prepare dissection solution by mixing HBSS without calcium and magnesium with 0.25% D-Glucose, keeping it at 4°C.
Prepare culture medium by supplementing MEM with 10% Nu serum, 15 mM HEPES pH 7.2, 0.45% glucose, 1 mM sodium pyruvate, 2 mM L-glutamine, and 10 IU/ml penicillin-streptomycin.
Prepare culture feeding medium by supplementing MEM with 2% B27, 15 mM HEPES, 0.45% glucose, 1 mM sodium pyruvate, and 2 mM glutamine.
Dissolve Poly-L-lysine at 0.1 mg/mL in water, aliquot, and store at -20°C.
Cover the coverslip or dish with Poly-L-lysine solution.
Incubate overnight at 37°C.
Rinse twice in water.
Let dry under a sterile laminar hood.
Prepare cells from E18-19 hippocampal neurons for glia-neuron co-culture using defined media.
Rinse hippocampi twice in cooled dissection solution.
Dissect hippocampi free of meninges in cooled dissection solution.
Incubate hippocampi with trypsin solution at 0.25% final concentration for 15 minutes at 37°C.
Stop the trypsin action by washing two times with HBSS or MEM.
Resuspend tissue in a final volume of 1 to 3 mL of MEM containing 10% fetal calf serum.
Triturate tissue using a P1000 micropipette ten times.
Wait one to two minutes until non-dissociated tissue settles at the bottom of the tube.
Transfer dissociated cells into a new tube.
Add 2 mL of HBSS to remaining non-dissociated clusters and push through Pasteur pipette five to ten times for complete dissociation.
Transfer the completely dissociated cells to the tube containing the first set of dissociated cells.
Count the number of cells.
Dilute dissociated neurons to the desired concentration with culture medium.
Plate the cells onto polylysine-coated dishes or coverslips according to optimization results.
Grow the cells in 5% CO2 and 37°C without a glial feeder cell layer in 10% Nu tissue culture medium until the desired time point for transfection.
Change 50% of old medium with fresh culture feeding medium every 3 days starting from 10 DIV.
Add B27 to the culture medium for optimal neuronal growth prior to Magnetofection.
Seed or plate cells the day before transfection, ensuring at least 60% confluence by the time of transfection.
Optimize cell density based on the planned interval between transfection and analysis of transgene expression.
Exchange 50% of the culture media 24 hours before transfection.
Vortex the NeuroMag reagent and place the appropriate amount in a microtube.
Dilute the indicated quantity of DNA in 50 to 700 μL of culture medium without serum and supplement.
Add the DNA solution to the NeuroMag solution by vigorous pipetting or brief vortexing and incubate at room temperature for 15 to 20 minutes.
Add the NeuroMag/DNA complexes onto cells drop by drop and gently rock the plate to ensure a uniform distribution.
Place the cell culture plate on the magnetic plate during 15 minutes.
Remove the magnetic plate.
Cultivate cells at 37°C in a CO2 incubator under standard conditions.
Optimize one parameter at a time while keeping other parameters constant.
Increase or decrease the amount of DNA to achieve optimal transfection efficiency.
Maintain a fixed ratio of NeuroMag reagent to DNA (3.5 µL / µg DNA) during optimization.
Vary the quantity of DNA over the suggested range for optimization.
First, maintain a fixed quantity of DNA according to culture dish size and cell number.
Then vary the amount of NeuroMag reagent from 2 to 5 µL per 1 μg of DNA.
Incubate cells until optimal confluency is achieved for transfection efficiency.
Monitor transfection efficiency after 24 hours up to several days by analyzing gene product.
Mix the same amount of each plasmid DNA and complex with NeuroMag for co-transfection.
Transfect cells with one plasmid DNA first.
Wait 4 h to 24 h after the first transfection.
Transfect cells with the second plasmid DNA.
Change the medium between the two transfections if required.
